name: Markets
author: CostaFot
description: Stocks, crypto and currencies in the bar: a live ticker strip plus a keyboard-driven panel with search, watchlist, favorites, portfolio and charts.

barWidget.description: Live prices for the instruments you follow. Click for the panel.

schema.label: Strip shows
schema.description: Which instruments the bar strip lists; portfolio is the holdings' total and today's move.

schema.label: Show price in strip
schema.description: Off shows only the change percentage.

schema.label: Strip entries
schema.description: Most entries the strip lists before trimming for width.

schema.label: Price refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: 0 = off; the panel still refreshes when opened.

schema.label: Portfolio currency
schema.description: Currency for portfolio totals. Other holdings are converted into it with ECB rates.

schema.label: Show rate-limit warnings
schema.description: Show a banner when prices are stale from provider rate-limiting.
